title: OpenStax: gas exchange is placed in alveolar sacs
summary: OpenStax says bronchioles lead to alveolar sacs in the respiratory zone, where gas exchange occurs, and that an alveolus is one of the small sacs.
body: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, section 22.1, says bronchioles lead to alveolar sacs in the respiratory zone, where gas exchange occurs. It says an alveolar duct opens into a cluster of alveoli, and that an alveolus is one of the many small, grape-like sacs. NHLBI describes gas exchange as oxygen entering the blood and carbon dioxide leaving it. This card is the textbook's placement of that exchange in the alveoli.

sources.title: 22.1 Organs and Structures of the Respiratory System
sources.author: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e
sources.note: Page opened 2026-11-18. OpenStax is a textbook, not a measurement body.
